entities.title: Infrastructure (lodestar-infrastructure)
entities.summary: The crate that implements the inner layers' traits on the real machine: so far, pilot records as files.
entities.purpose: A workspace crate that depends on lodestar-core and implements the saving feature's PilotStore with PilotFiles: one <NAME>.pilot text file per pilot in one folder.
boundaries: The record's format and whether it is accepted are the saving feature's; this crate only stores and fetches text.
